Name: Living Limerick City Centre Initiative - Living Georgian City -33/34 Thomas Street
Description:
This project is funded by the Urban Regeneration and Development Fund
Mixed use Residential Development Projects.  The LGC programme is an active programme having already received funding under the first URDF call. This programme seeks to address the housing challenge in historic city cores. 

33/34 Thomas Street: Provision of 13 x No. apartment units. The proposed development consists of a change of use from single house to apartments and re-modelling of the existing four-storey-over-basement Georgian terraced house at No. 33 Thomas Street to provide 5 x No. one bedroom apartments.  The proposed Development also consists of demolition of the former fire station structure at No. 34 Thomas Street to provide two ranges of residential apartments around an internal courtyard - one facing onto Thomas Street and the other along the rear boundary of the site. Connected by a staircase and passenger lift structure, the proposed new apartment structure is five-storeys tall, comprising retail / commercial, community and storage uses at ground floor level, with apartments at first, second, third and fourth floor levels.
Fund: This project is funded by the Urban Regeneration and Development Fund
